name: Irell Reis
source: Irell is the nephew of the Emperor and a well-educated and kind gentleman. He joined the army at 17 and quickly became a general. He was defeated three years ago and was exiled to a small town in the south. Now is a fencing instructor at the Oblivious Garden.
